title: Predicted-paper builder (UI surface over PR-19's frequency anchor)
summary: UI surface over the pastPaperFrequencyAnchor library that PR-19 (audit #38) shipped but never gave a teacher-facing entry point. Teacher picks subject + tier + year-group + 'Past papers to anchor against' (multi-select 2019–2024 default) + 'Bias toward unseen topics' slider; the builder inverts the frequency weighting so the assembly biases toward topics that are UNDER-represented in the supplied corpus. Reuses createExamPaperBuilder.ts's mark-band knapsack via a thin adapter.
motivation: MathsGenie 'predicted papers' is the single most-downloaded GCSE revision format pre-exam season — explicit copy on the site reads 'topics least likely to come up in paper 3 removed'. PR-19 already ships the frequency-anchor logic; the only thing missing is the UI to drive it.

in: client/src/pages/tools/PredictedExamPaper.tsx (new, ~200 LoC) — wraps CreateExamPaper.tsx form with anchor multi-select + bias slider
client/src/lib/tool-registry.ts — append ToolEntry { id: 'predicted-paper', hub: 'revision', icon: Sparkle }
client/src/pages/hubs/RevisionHubSection.tsx — append a 7th storyboard step 'Build a predicted paper'

Targeted vitest in client/src/lib/__tests__/predictedPaperBuilder.test.ts (~10 cases): bias=0 produces same distribution as createExamPaperBuilder; bias=1 fully inverts; output is seed-deterministic; over-anchored corpus falls back gracefully
out: Production past-paper question-frequency corpus loader (deferred to H7; today the corpus is caller-injected)
Live-update UI ('predicted paper for next month') (deferred to PR-28; needs a corpus refresh job)
Auto-detection of awarding body's exam season (deferred — heuristic; teachers can pick)

bias_semantics.bias=0.5: moderate inversion — under-represented topics weighted 1.5×, over-represented 0.5×
bias_semantics.bias=1: full inversion — top-quartile-frequency topics excluded, bottom-quartile weighted 2×

acceptance_criteria: bias=0 output is structurally identical to a createExamPaperBuilder call with the same params.
bias=1 output excludes every topic that appeared in ≥75th percentile of the anchor corpus.
Same (params, seed) produce identical predicted papers across two runs.
When the anchor corpus is empty, the builder returns the createExamPaperBuilder output + a warning 'No anchor corpus supplied — falling back to neutral frequency'.
Per-topic floor (every requested topic ≥1 question) is preserved even at bias=1, with a warning when this conflicts with the bias.

risk_register.risk: Corpus injection burden — teacher has to upload the anchor corpus
risk_register.mitigation: v1 ships pre-bundled 2019-2024 corpus for AQA / Edexcel / OCR (paraphrased, not verbatim — same paraphrasing convention as the curriculum bank exemplars). Teachers can override.

risk_register.risk: Predictions drift over the year as more recent papers ship
risk_register.mitigation: Corpus is a JSON file with last-updated date; admin panel surfaces staleness >12 months.
